# CivicAI Lampung

Dokumen ini menggabungkan dua file kode sumber CivicAI Lampung dalam satu file Markdown.

## 1. Beranda Publik

          <div class="bg-white rounded-[8px] p-5 border border-lineBorder shadow-hairline hover:shadow-card hover:border-primary/40 transition-all group">
            <div class="flex items-start justify-between">
              <div class="w-10 h-10 rounded-[6px] bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 flex items-center justify-center group-hover:bg-emerald-600 group-hover:text-white transition-colors">
                <span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[22px]">delete_sweep</span>
              </div>
              <span class="text-[11px] font-mono text-textMuted bg-surfaceSec px-2 py-0.5 rounded">OPD: DLH</span>
            </div>
            <h3 class="font-heading font-bold text-base text-textMain mt-3.5 group-hover:text-emerald-700 transition-colors">Persampahan dan Kebersihan</h3>
            <p class="text-[12px] text-textSec mt-1 leading-relaxed">
              Tempat pembuangan sampah liar, tumpukan limbah tak terangkut di ruang publik, atau polusi lingkungan.
            </p>
            <div class="mt-4 pt-3 border-t border-lineBorder/60 flex items-center justify-between text-[11px]">
              <span class="text-textMuted italic">Contoh: "Timbunan sampah liar di bahu jalan lintas timur"</span>
              <span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[16px] text-emerald-700 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity">chevron_right</span>
            </div>
          </div>

          <!-- Card 4: Penerangan Jalan -->
          <div class="bg-white rounded-[8px] p-5 border border-lineBorder shadow-hairline hover:shadow-card hover:border-primary/40 transition-all group">
            <div class="flex items-start justify-between">
              <div class="w-10 h-10 rounded-[6px] bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 flex items-center justify-center group-hover:bg-amber-600 group-hover:text-white transition-colors">
                <span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[22px]">light</span>
              </div>
              <span class="text-[11px] font-mono text-textMuted bg-surfaceSec px-2 py-0.5 rounded">OPD: Dishub</span>
            </div>
            <h3 class="font-heading font-bold text-base text-textMain mt-3.5 group-hover:text-amber-700 transition-colors">Penerangan Jalan</h3>
            <p class="text-[12px] text-textSec mt-1 leading-relaxed">
              Lampu penerangan jalan umum (LPJU) padam, tiang lampu roboh, kabel menjuntai berisiko korsleting.
            </p>
            <div class="mt-4 pt-3 border-t border-lineBorder/60 flex items-center justify-between text-[11px]">
              <span class="text-textMuted italic">Contoh: "Tiga tiang LPJU padam di ruas By Pass Soekarno Hatta"</span>
              <span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[16px] text-amber-700 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity">chevron_right</span>
            </div>
          </div>

          <!-- Card 5: Fasilitas Umum -->
          <div class="bg-white rounded-[8px] p-5 border border-lineBorder shadow-hairline hover:shadow-card hover:border-primary/40 transition-all group">
            <div class="flex items-start justify-between">
              <div class="w-10 h-10 rounded-[6px] bg-primary-tint text-primary flex items-center justify-center group-hover:bg-primary group-hover:text-white transition-colors">
                <span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[22px]">domain</span>
              </div>
              <span class="text-[11px] font-mono text-textMuted bg-surfaceSec px-2 py-0.5 rounded">OPD: Cipta Karya</span>
            </div>
            <h3 class="font-heading font-bold text-base text-textMain mt-3.5 group-hover:text-primary transition-colors">Fasilitas Umum</h3>
            <p class="text-[12px] text-textSec mt-1 leading-relaxed">
              Kerusakan halte bus, taman kota terlantar, rambu lalu lintas roboh, atau sarana disabilitas rusak.
            </p>
            <div class="mt-4 pt-3 border-t border-lineBorder/60 flex items-center justify-between text-[11px]">
              <span class="text-textMuted italic">Contoh: "Atap halte bus dekat kampus Teknokrat pecah"</span>
              <span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[16px] text-primary opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity">chevron_right</span>
            </div>
          </div>

          <!-- Card 6: Pelayanan Publik -->
          <div class="bg-white rounded-[8px] p-5 border border-lineBorder shadow-hairline hover:shadow-card hover:border-primary/40 transition-all group">
            <div class="flex items-start justify-between">
              <div class="w-10 h-10 rounded-[6px] bg-ai-tint text-ai-violet flex items-center justify-center group-hover:bg-ai-violet group-hover:text-white transition-colors">
                <span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[22px]">badge</span>
              </div>
              <span class="text-[11px] font-mono text-textMuted bg-surfaceSec px-2 py-0.5 rounded">OPD: Biro Ortala</span>
            </div>
            <h3 class="font-heading font-bold text-base text-textMain mt-3.5 group-hover:text-ai-violet transition-colors">Pelayanan Publik</h3>
            <p class="text-[12px] text-textSec mt-1 leading-relaxed">
              Keluhan administrasi kependudukan, perizinan terhambat, transparansi SOP, atau disiplin layanan kantor dinas.
            </p>
            <div class="mt-4 pt-3 border-t border-lineBorder/60 flex items-center justify-between text-[11px]">
              <span class="text-textMuted italic">Contoh: "Antrean loket layanan terhambat lebih dari 3 jam"</span>
              <span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[16px] text-ai-violet opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity">chevron_right</span>
            </div>
          </div>

        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <!-- SECTION: CARA KERJA (4-step horizontal flow) -->
    <section id="panduan" class="py-16 bg-white border-y border-lineBorder">
      <div class="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8">
        
        <div class="text-center max-w-2xl mx-auto mb-14">
          <div class="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-primary text-[11px] font-semibold font-mono tracking-wider uppercase mb-1">
            <span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[15px]">alt_route</span>
            <span>Transparansi Proses</span>
          </div>
          <h2 class="font-heading font-bold text-2xl sm:text-3xl text-textMain">Cara Kerja CivicAI</h2>
          <p class="text-sm text-textSec mt-1.5">Alur terstruktur dari penyampaian laporan hingga penuntasan di lapangan oleh pemerintah daerah.</p>
        </div>

        <div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-6 relative">
          
          <!-- Connector Line (visible on md+) -->
          <div class="hidden md:block absolute top-7 left-[12%] right-[12%] h-[2px] bg-gradient-to-r from-primary-tint via-primary-tint2 to-secondary-tint z-0"></div>

          <!-- Step 1 -->
          <div class="relative z-10 flex flex-col items-center text-center">
            <div class="w-14 h-14 rounded-full bg-white border-2 border-primary shadow-xs flex items-center justify-center text-primary font-heading font-bold text-lg mb-4">
              <span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[24px]">send</span>
            </div>
            <span class="text-[11px] font-mono font-semibold text-primary px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-primary-tint mb-2">LANGKAH 01</span>
            <h3 class="font-heading font-bold text-base text-textMain">Kirim Laporan</h3>
            <p class="text-[12px] text-textSec mt-1.5 leading-relaxed">
              Warga mengisi formulir dengan detail lokasi, foto bukti kejadian, dan deskripsi singkat masalah.
            </p>
          </div>

          <!-- Step 2 -->
          <div class="relative z-10 flex flex-col items-center text-center">
            <div class="w-14 h-14 rounded-full bg-white border-2 border-ai-violet shadow-xs flex items-center justify-center text-ai-violet font-heading font-bold text-lg mb-4">
              <span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[24px]">fact_check</span>
            </div>
            <span class="text-[11px] font-mono font-semibold text-ai-text px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-ai-tint mb-2">LANGKAH 02</span>
            <h3 class="font-heading font-bold text-base text-textMain">Diverifikasi Petugas</h3>
            <p class="text-[12px] text-textSec mt-1.5 leading-relaxed">
              Petugas verifikator meninjau keabsahan berkas dengan rekomendasi klasifikasi cerdas dari AI.
            </p>
          </div>

          <!-- Step 3 -->
          <div class="relative z-10 flex flex-col items-center text-center">
            <div class="w-14 h-14 rounded-full bg-white border-2 border-secondary shadow-xs flex items-center justify-center text-secondary-text font-heading font-bold text-lg mb-4">
              <span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[24px]">assignment_turned_in</span>
            </div>
            <span class="text-[11px] font-mono font-semibold text-secondary-text px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-secondary-tint mb-2">LANGKAH 03</span>
            <h3 class="font-heading font-bold text-base text-textMain">Ditugaskan ke OPD</h3>
            <p class="text-[12px] text-textSec mt-1.5 leading-relaxed">
              Tiket diteruskan ke dinas teknis penanggung jawab untuk survei dan perbaikan langsung di lapangan.
            </p>
          </div>

          <!-- Step 4 -->
          <div class="relative z-10 flex flex-col items-center text-center">
            <div class="w-14 h-14 rounded-full bg-white border-2 border-success shadow-xs flex items-center justify-center text-success-text font-heading font-bold text-lg mb-4">
              <span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[24px]">verified</span>
            </div>
            <span class="text-[11px] font-mono font-semibold text-success-text px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-success-tint mb-2">LANGKAH 04</span>
            <h3 class="font-heading font-bold text-base text-textMain">Pantau Sampai Selesai</h3>
            <p class="text-[12px] text-textSec mt-1.5 leading-relaxed">
              Pelapor menerima notifikasi pembaruan berkala hingga laporan dinyatakan tuntas dengan bukti foto final.
            </p>
          </div>

        </div>

        <!-- AI ETHICS & TRANSPARENCY CARD -->
        <div class="mt-14 max-w-4xl mx-auto bg-gradient-to-r from-ai-tint/70 via-white to-primary-tint/60 rounded-[8px] p-5 sm:p-6 border border-ai-border shadow-hairline flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-start sm:items-center gap-4">
          <div class="w-11 h-11 rounded-[6px] bg-gradient-to-br from-ai-violet to-primary text-white flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 shadow-xs">
            <span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[22px]">smart_toy</span>
          </div>
          <div class="flex-grow">
            <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
              <span class="text-[11px] font-mono font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-ai-text">Prinsip AI Penasihat (Human-in-the-Loop)</span>
              <span class="text-[10px] bg-white border border-ai-border text-ai-violet px-1.5 rounded font-mono font-medium">ADVISORY ONLY</span>
            </div>
            <p class="text-[13px] text-textMain mt-1 font-medium leading-relaxed">
              "AI hanya membantu petugas mengelompokkan laporan, mendeteksi potensi duplikasi, dan menyarankan OPD tujuan. Keputusan akhir selalu ada pada petugas berwenang."
            </p>
          </div>
          <a href="#tentang-ai" class="shrink-0 text-[12px] font-semibold text-primary hover:text-primary-hover flex items-center gap-1">
            <span>Pelajari Tata Kelola</span>
            <span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[16px]">open_in_new</span>
          </a>
        </div>

      </div>
    </section>

    <!-- SECTION: CALL TO ACTION BOTTOM (Citizen Engagement) -->
    <section class="py-14 bg-gradient-to-b from-slatebg to-[#EDF2FA]">
      <div class="max-w-5xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 text-center">
        <h2 class="font-heading font-bold text-2xl sm:text-3xl text-textMain">
          Punya Keluhan Terkait Fasilitas di Sekitar Anda?
        </h2>
        <p class="text-textSec text-sm sm:text-base mt-2 max-w-xl mx-auto">
          Laporkan sekarang dengan melampirkan foto serta lokasi akurat. Suara Anda berkontribusi langsung bagi pembangunan Provinsi Lampung.
        </p>
        <div class="mt-6 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-3">
          <a href="#buat-pengaduan" class="h-10 px-6 inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-[4px] text-[14px] font-semibold text-white bg-primary hover:bg-primary-hover shadow-hairline transition-all">
            <span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[18px]">edit_note</span>
            <span>Mulai Buat Pengaduan Sekarang</span>
          </a>
          <a href="#panduan" class="h-10 px-5 inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-[4px] text-[14px] font-semibold text-textSec bg-white hover:bg-slate-50 border border-lineBorder transition-all">
            <span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[18px]">help_outline</span>
            <span>Panduan & FAQ</span>
          </a>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

  </main>

  <!-- MANDATORY FOOTER (Exact text, never covered by modals or navigation) -->
  <footer class="bg-white border-t border-lineBorder py-6">
    <div class="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8">
      <div class="flex flex-col md:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-4 text-xs text-textSec">
        
        <!-- Left: Logo & Partnership description -->
        <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
          <span class="font-heading font-bold text-sm text-textMain">CivicAI Lampung</span>
          <span class="text-textMuted">•</span>
          <span>Kolaborasi Resmi Pemerintah Provinsi Lampung & Universitas Teknokrat Indonesia</span>
        </div>

        <!-- Center / Exact Mandatory Copyright Text -->
        <div class="text-center font-medium text-textMain bg-slatebg px-3 py-1 rounded border border-lineBorder">
          Copyright©2026 by Putri Cahyani dan Dr. Erliyan Redy Susanto, M.Kom
        </div>

        <!-- Right: Legal Links -->
        <div class="flex items-center gap-4 text-textMuted">
          <a href="#privasi" class="hover:text-primary transition-colors">Kebijakan Privasi</a>
          <a href="#syarat" class="hover:text-primary transition-colors">Syarat & Ketentuan</a>
          <a href="#kontak" class="hover:text-primary transition-colors">Kontak Kami</a>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </footer>

</body>
</html>

<div class="flex items-center gap-space-sm">
<span class="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded bg-primary-fixed text-on-primary-fixed font-data-mono text-data-mono font-medium">

<span>Protokol Enkripsi TLS 1.3 Aktif</span>
</div>
</div>
</div>

<div class="flex items-center gap-4">

<script>
  function switchTab(tabName) {
    const loginSection = document.getElementById('section-login');
    const registerSection = document.getElementById('section-register');
    const loginBtn = document.getElementById('tab-login-btn');
    const registerBtn = document.getElementById('tab-register-btn');

    if (tabName === 'login') {
      loginSection.classList.remove('hidden');
      registerSection.classList.add('hidden');
      
      loginBtn.className = "flex-1 py-2 rounded text-center font-title-md text-title-md transition-all duration-200 bg-surface-container-lowest text-primary shadow-sm flex items-center justify-center gap-2";
      registerBtn.className = "flex-1 py-2 rounded text-center font-title-md text-title-md transition-all duration-200 text-on-surface-variant hover:text-on-surface flex items-center justify-center gap-2";
    } else {
      loginSection.classList.add('hidden');
      registerSection.classList.remove('hidden');
      
      registerBtn.className = "flex-1 py-2 rounded text-center font-title-md text-title-md transition-all duration-200 bg-surface-container-lowest text-primary shadow-sm flex items-center justify-center gap-2";
      loginBtn.className = "flex-1 py-2 rounded text-center font-title-md text-title-md transition-all duration-200 text-on-surface-variant hover:text-on-surface flex items-center justify-center gap-2";
    }
  }

  function togglePasswordVisibility(inputId, iconId) {
    const pwdInput = document.getElementById(inputId);
    const eyeIcon = document.getElementById(iconId);
    if (pwdInput.type === "password") {
      pwdInput.type = "text";
      eyeIcon.textContent = "visibility_off";
    } else {
      pwdInput.type = "password";
      eyeIcon.textContent = "visibility";
    }
  }

  function showOtpModal() {
    const otpCard = document.getElementById('otp-card');
    otpCard.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
    otpCard.classList.add('ring-2', 'ring-primary');
    setTimeout(() => {
      otpCard.classList.remove('ring-2', 'ring-primary');
    }, 1500);
  }

  // Interactive 48-second countdown simulation
  (function initCountdown() {
    let timeLeft = 48;
    const countdownEl = document.getElementById('countdown');
    if (!countdownEl) return;
    
    setInterval(() => {
      if (timeLeft > 0) {
        timeLeft--;
        const formatted = timeLeft < 10 ? '0' + timeLeft : timeLeft;
        countdownEl.textContent = '00:' + formatted;
      }
    }, 1000);
  })();
</script></main><footer class="w-full bg-surface-container-lowest shadow-[0_-1px_6px_rgba(0,0,0,0.02)] py-space-md"><div class="w-full px-margin md:px-margin-tablet lg:px-margin-desktop flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-space-xs text-center sm:text-left"><p class="font-label-sm text-label-sm text-on-surface-variant tracking-normal">Copyright©2026 by Putri Cahyani dan Dr. Erliyan Redy Susanto, M.Kom.</p><div class="flex items-center gap-space-md font-label-sm text-label-sm text-on-surface-variant"><span class="inline-flex items-center gap-1"><span class="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-secondary"></span>Sistem Terpadu Pelayanan Publik</span><span>|</span><span>Provinsi Lampung</span></div></div></footer></body></html>

<script>
  function copyTicketId() {
    const ticketText = '#LPG-2026-0842';
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(ticketText).then(() => {
      const tooltip = document.getElementById('copyTooltip');
      if (tooltip) {
        tooltip.classList.remove('opacity-0');
        tooltip.classList.add('opacity-100');
        setTimeout(() => {
          tooltip.classList.remove('opacity-100');
          tooltip.classList.add('opacity-0');
        }, 2200);
      }
    }).catch(err => {
      console.error('Gagal menyalin:', err);
    });
  }

  function downloadReceipt() {
    const notification = document.createElement('div');
    notification.className = 'fixed bottom-6 right-6 z-50 bg-inverse-surface text-inverse-on-surface px-4 py-3 rounded-lg shadow-lg flex items-center gap-2 font-body-medium text-body-medium transition-all transform translate-y-0';
    notification.innerHTML = `
      <span class="material-symbols-outlined text-secondary text-[20px]">check_circle</span>
      <span>Tanda terima digital (#LPG-2026-0842.pdf) sedang disiapkan...</span>
    `;
    document.body.appendChild(notification);
    setTimeout(() => {
      notification.classList.add('opacity-0', 'translate-y-2');
      setTimeout(() => notification.remove(), 400);
    }, 2500);
  }
</script></main><footer class="w-full bg-surface-container-lowest shadow-[0_-1px_6px_rgba(0,0,0,0.02)] py-space-lg px-space-xl"><div class="flex flex-col md:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-space-sm font-label-sm text-label-sm text-on-surface-variant"><div class="text-center md:text-left"><span>Copyright©2026 by Putri Cahyani dan Dr. Erliyan Redy Susanto, M.Kom.</span></div><div class="flex items-center gap-2 text-center md:text-right font-medium text-on-surface-variant"><span>Kolaborasi Riset Strategis:</span><span class="font-semibold text-on-surface">Pemerintah Provinsi Lampung</span><span>&amp;</span><span class="font-semibold text-on-surface">Universitas Teknokrat Indonesia</span></div></div></footer></div></body></html>

<script>
  function selectTicket(ticketId) {
    // Micro-interaction for selecting rows and updating drawer header
    const detailPanel = document.getElementById('ticket-detail-panel');
    if (!detailPanel) return;

    // Visual feedback highlight
    detailPanel.classList.add('ring-2', 'ring-primary');
    setTimeout(() => {
      detailPanel.classList.remove('ring-2', 'ring-primary');
    }, 400);
  }

  // Filter chips click interaction
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    const chips = document.querySelectorAll('#status-chips button');
    chips.forEach(chip => {
      chip.addEventListener('click', () => {
        chips.forEach(c => {
          c.className = "px-3 py-1 rounded-full font-label-sm text-label-sm font-medium bg-surface-container-low text-on-surface-variant hover:bg-surface-container hover:text-on-surface transition-all";
        });
        chip.className = "px-3 py-1 rounded-full font-label-sm text-label-sm font-semibold bg-primary text-on-primary shadow-xs transition-all";
      });
    });
  });
</script></main><footer class="w-full bg-surface-container-lowest shadow-[0_-1px_6px_rgba(0,0,0,0.02)] py-space-lg px-space-xl"><div class="flex flex-col md:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-space-sm font-label-sm text-label-sm text-on-surface-variant"><div class="text-center md:text-left"><span>Copyright©2026 by Putri Cahyani dan Dr. Erliyan Redy Susanto, M.Kom.</span></div><div class="flex items-center gap-2 text-center md:text-right font-medium text-on-surface-variant"><span>Kolaborasi Riset Strategis:</span><span class="font-semibold text-on-surface">Pemerintah Provinsi Lampung</span><span>&amp;</span><span class="font-semibold text-on-surface">Universitas Teknokrat Indonesia</span></div></div></footer></div></body></html>

<!-- INTERACTION SCRIPTS -->
<script>
    function copyTicket() {
      const ticketId = '#LPG-2026-0842';
      navigator.clipboard.writeText(ticketId).then(() => {
        const textSpan = document.getElementById('copyText');
        const iconSpan = document.getElementById('copyIcon');
        textSpan.innerText = 'Tersalin!';
        iconSpan.innerText = 'done';
        setTimeout(() => {
          textSpan.innerText = 'Salin';
          iconSpan.innerText = 'content_copy';
        }, 2000);
      });
    }

    let selectedRating = 0;
    function setRating(rating) {
      selectedRating = rating;
      const buttons = document.querySelectorAll('.star-btn');
      const captions = [
        'Klik pada bintang untuk memberi skor',
        '1 Bintang - Sangat Tidak Puas',
        '2 Bintang - Kurang Memuaskan',
        '3 Bintang - Cukup Baik',
        '4 Bintang - Memuaskan & Cepat',
        '5 Bintang - Sangat Sempurna & Tanggap'
      ];
      buttons.forEach((btn, idx) => {
        const star = btn.querySelector('.material-symbols-outlined');
        if (idx < rating) {
          btn.classList.add('text-amber-500');
          btn.classList.remove('text-outline');
          star.setAttribute('style', "font-variation-settings: 'FILL' 1;");
        } else {
          btn.classList.remove('text-amber-500');
          btn.classList.add('text-outline');
          star.removeAttribute('style');
        }
      });
      document.getElementById('ratingCaption').innerText = captions[rating];
    }

    function handleClarify(e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      const val = document.getElementById('clarifyInput').value.trim();
      if (!val) {
        alert('Mohon tuliskan penjelasan klarifikasi terlebih dahulu.');
        return;
      }
      document.getElementById('clarifyInput').value = '';
      const successMsg = document.getElementById('clarifySuccess');
      successMsg.classList.remove('hidden');
      setTimeout(() => {
        successMsg.classList.add('hidden');
      }, 4000);
    }

    function confirmResolution() {
      const feedback = document.getElementById('resolutionFeedback');
      feedback.classList.remove('hidden');
      feedback.innerText = 'Terima kasih! Tiket #LPG-2026-0842 berhasil Anda konfirmasi selesai dan nilai telah direkam.';
    }

    function reopenTicket() {
      const feedback = document.getElementById('resolutionFeedback');
      feedback.classList.remove('hidden');
      feedback.innerText = 'Sanggahan telah dikirimkan. Tiket dibuka kembali dan diarahkan ke Tim Pengawas Khusus.';
    }
  </script>

<script>
  // Simple interactive feedback for ticket lookup simulation
  document.querySelector('form')?.addEventListener('submit', function() {
    const btn = this.querySelector('button[type="submit"]');
    if (!btn) return;
    const originalText = btn.innerHTML;
    btn.innerHTML = '<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[20px] animate-spin">refresh</span><span>Memverifikasi...</span>';
    btn.disabled = true;
    setTimeout(() => {
      btn.innerHTML = originalText;
      btn.disabled = false;
      const resultCard = document.querySelector('article');
      if (resultCard) {
        resultCard.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
      }
    }, 450);
  });
</script></main>

<!-- Interactive Filter & Read State Script -->
<script>
    (function() {
      const tabAll = document.getElementById('tabAll');
      const tabUnread = document.getElementById('tabUnread');
      const cards = document.querySelectorAll('.notification-card');
      const markAllBtn = document.getElementById('markAllReadBtn');

      function setTab(activeTab, inactiveTab) {
        activeTab.classList.add('bg-surface-container-lowest', 'text-on-surface', 'shadow-sm', 'font-semibold');
        activeTab.classList.remove('text-on-surface-variant');
        inactiveTab.classList.remove('bg-surface-container-lowest', 'text-on-surface', 'shadow-sm', 'font-semibold');
        inactiveTab.classList.add('text-on-surface-variant');
      }

      tabAll.addEventListener('click', () => {
        setTab(tabAll, tabUnread);
        cards.forEach(card => card.style.display = 'flex');
      });

      tabUnread.addEventListener('click', () => {
        setTab(tabUnread, tabAll);
        cards.forEach(card => {
          if (card.getAttribute('data-status') === 'unread') {
            card.style.display = 'flex';
          } else {
            card.style.display = 'none';
          }
        });
      });

      markAllBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        cards.forEach(card => {
          card.setAttribute('data-status', 'read');
          card.classList.remove('unread');
          const dot = card.querySelector('.bg-primary.rounded-full');
          if (dot) {
            dot.remove();
          }
        });
        const unreadCountBadge = document.querySelector('.font-data-mono.bg-primary');
        if (unreadCountBadge) {
          unreadCountBadge.textContent = '0 Baru';
          unreadCountBadge.classList.replace('bg-primary', 'bg-surface-container-high');
          unreadCountBadge.classList.replace('text-on-primary', 'text-on-surface-variant');
        }
        tabUnread.querySelector('span:last-child').textContent = '0';
      });
    })();
  </script>

<!-- Client-side Interactive Behaviors -->
<script>
  function toggleExportMenu() {
    const menu = document.getElementById('exportMenu');
    if (menu) {
      menu.classList.toggle('hidden');
    }
  }

  function triggerExport(type) {
    const menu = document.getElementById('exportMenu');
    if (menu) menu.classList.add('hidden');
    
    // Non-blocking toast indicator
    const toast = document.createElement('div');
    toast.className = 'fixed bottom-6 right-6 bg-inverse-surface text-inverse-on-surface px-4 py-3 rounded-lg shadow-xl z-50 flex items-center gap-2 font-body-default text-body-default animate-bounce';
    toast.innerHTML = `<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-secondary-fixed text-[20px]">check_circle</span> Mengunduh Dokumen Agregat (${type}) CivicAI Lampung...`;
    document.body.appendChild(toast);
    
    setTimeout(() => {
      toast.remove();
    }, 2800);
  }

  function selectPeriod(period) {
    const btnQ = document.getElementById('btn-period-q');
    const btnY = document.getElementById('btn-period-y');
    const btnM = document.getElementById('btn-period-m');
    
    [btnQ, btnY, btnM].forEach(b => {
      b.className = 'px-3 py-1.5 rounded text-on-surface-variant font-body-medium text-body-medium hover:text-on-surface transition-all';
    });

    const activeBtn = period === 'Q' ? btnQ : (period === 'Y' ? btnY : btnM);
    activeBtn.className = 'px-3 py-1.5 rounded bg-surface-container-lowest text-primary font-body-medium text-body-medium font-semibold shadow-sm transition-all';
  }

  // Close export dropdown when clicking outside
  document.addEventListener('click', function(event) {
    const btn = document.getElementById('exportBtn');
    const menu = document.getElementById('exportMenu');
    if (btn && menu && !btn.contains(event.target) && !menu.contains(event.target)) {
      menu.classList.add('hidden');
    }
  });
</script></main><footer class="w-full bg-surface-container-lowest shadow-[0_-1px_6px_rgba(0,0,0,0.02)] py-space-lg px-space-xl"><div class="flex flex-col md:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-space-sm font-label-sm text-label-sm text-on-surface-variant"><div class="text-center md:text-left"><span>Copyright©2026 by Putri Cahyani dan Dr. Erliyan Redy Susanto, M.Kom.</span></div><div class="flex items-center gap-2 text-center md:text-right font-medium text-on-surface-variant"><span>Kolaborasi Riset Strategis:</span><span class="font-semibold text-on-surface">Pemerintah Provinsi Lampung</span><span>&amp;</span><span class="font-semibold text-on-surface">Universitas Teknokrat Indonesia</span></div></div></footer></div></body></html>

<!-- Micro-interactions Script -->
<script>
    // Tab switching
    const tabs = document.querySelectorAll('#settings-tab-list .tab-button');
    const contents = document.querySelectorAll('.tab-content');

    tabs.forEach(tab => {
      tab.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const targetId = tab.getAttribute('data-tab-target');
        
        // Reset buttons style
        tabs.forEach(t => {
          t.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'false');
          t.className = 'tab-button inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-lg font-title-md text-title-md transition-all text-on-surface-variant hover:bg-surface-container hover:text-on-surface';
        });

        // Activate clicked button
        tab.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'true');
        tab.className = 'tab-button inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-lg font-title-md text-title-md transition-all bg-primary text-on-primary shadow-sm';

        // Toggle content
        contents.forEach(content => {
          if (content.id === targetId) {
            content.classList.remove('hidden');
            content.classList.add('block');
          } else {
            content.classList.remove('block');
            content.classList.add('hidden');
          }
        });
      });
    });

    // Toggle NIK visibility with simulation feedback
    const btnToggleNik = document.getElementById('btn-toggle-nik');
    const nikInput = document.getElementById('nik-input');
    let nikMasked = true;

    if (btnToggleNik && nikInput) {
      btnToggleNik.addEventListener('click', () => {
        if (nikMasked) {
          nikInput.value = '1871031201940042';
          btnToggleNik.innerHTML = '<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[18px]">visibility_off</span>';
          nikMasked = false;
        } else {
          nikInput.value = '1871**********0042';
          btnToggleNik.innerHTML = '<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[18px]">visibility</span>';
          nikMasked = true;
        }
      });
    }

    // Toggle Password Visibility Helper
    function togglePassVisibility(inputId, btn) {
      const input = document.getElementById(inputId);
      if (!input) return;
      const isPass = input.type === 'password';
      input.type = isPass ? 'text' : 'password';
      btn.innerHTML = `<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[18px]">${isPass ? 'visibility_off' : 'visibility'}</span>`;
    }

    // Password strength calculation
    function evaluatePasswordStrength(val) {
      const b1 = document.getElementById('bar-1');
      const b2 = document.getElementById('bar-2');
      const b3 = document.getElementById('bar-3');
      const b4 = document.getElementById('bar-4');
      const lbl = document.getElementById('strength-label');
      if (!lbl) return;

      const len = val.length;
      if (len === 0) {
        lbl.textContent = 'Belum Diisi';
        lbl.className = 'font-semibold text-outline';
        [b1, b2, b3, b4].forEach(b => b.className = 'h-1.5 rounded-full bg-surface-container-high transition-all');
      } else if (len < 6) {
        lbl.textContent = 'Sangat Lemah';
        lbl.className = 'font-semibold text-error';
        b1.className = 'h-1.5 rounded-full bg-error transition-all';
        [b2, b3, b4].forEach(b => b.className = 'h-1.5 rounded-full bg-surface-container-high transition-all');
      } else if (len < 8) {
        lbl.textContent = 'Cukup';
        lbl.className = 'font-semibold text-on-surface-variant';
        b1.className = 'h-1.5 rounded-full bg-secondary-container transition-all';
        b2.className = 'h-1.5 rounded-full bg-secondary-container transition-all';
        [b3, b4].forEach(b => b.className = 'h-1.5 rounded-full bg-surface-container-high transition-all');
      } else if (len < 12) {
        lbl.textContent = 'Kuat';
        lbl.className = 'font-semibold text-secondary';
        b1.className = 'h-1.5 rounded-full bg-secondary transition-all';
        b2.className = 'h-1.5 rounded-full bg-secondary transition-all';
        b3.className = 'h-1.5 rounded-full bg-secondary transition-all';
        b4.className = 'h-1.5 rounded-full bg-surface-container-high transition-all';
      } else {
        lbl.textContent = 'Sangat Kuat';
        lbl.className = 'font-semibold text-secondary';
        [b1, b2, b3, b4].forEach(b => b.className = 'h-1.5 rounded-full bg-secondary transition-all');
      }
    }

    // Save Feedback Simulation
    const btnSaveProfile = document.getElementById('btn-save-profile');
    if (btnSaveProfile) {
      btnSaveProfile.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const originalHtml = btnSaveProfile.innerHTML;
        btnSaveProfile.innerHTML = '<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[18px] animate-spin">refresh</span> Menyimpan...';
        btnSaveProfile.disabled = true;
        setTimeout(() => {
          btnSaveProfile.innerHTML = '<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[18px]">check_circle</span> Tersimpan!';
          btnSaveProfile.classList.remove('bg-primary');
          btnSaveProfile.classList.add('bg-secondary');
          setTimeout(() => {
            btnSaveProfile.innerHTML = originalHtml;
            btnSaveProfile.classList.remove('bg-secondary');
            btnSaveProfile.classList.add('bg-primary');
            btnSaveProfile.disabled = false;
          }, 2000);
        }, 900);
      });
    }
  </script>
</div></main><footer class="w-full bg-surface-container-lowest shadow-[0_-1px_6px_rgba(0,0,0,0.02)] py-space-lg px-space-xl"><div class="flex flex-col md:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-space-sm font-label-sm text-label-sm text-on-surface-variant"><div class="text-center md:text-left"><span>Copyright©2026 by Putri Cahyani dan Dr. Erliyan Redy Susanto, M.Kom.</span></div><div class="flex items-center gap-2 text-center md:text-right font-medium text-on-surface-variant"><span>Kolaborasi Riset Strategis:</span><span class="font-semibold text-on-surface">Pemerintah Provinsi Lampung</span><span>&amp;</span><span class="font-semibold text-on-surface">Universitas Teknokrat Indonesia</span></div></div></footer></div></body></html>

            Ketika Anda mengunggah laporan dan foto kerusakan, sistem CivicAI menjalankan modul <em>Computer Vision &amp; Natural Language Processing (NLP)</em> yang dilatih secara khusus untuk geografi Lampung.

<span>Proses Human-in-the-Loop (ASN):</span>

<ul class="list-disc pl-5 space-y-1 font-body-default text-body-default text-on-surface-variant">
<li><strong>Pendeteksian Gambar:</strong> AI menganalisis kedalaman lubang jalan, retakan, atau tumpukan sampah untuk menentukan tingkat bahaya (Kritis, Sedang, Rendah).</li>
<li><strong>Pencegahan Duplikasi:</strong> Jika 5 warga melaporkan lubang jalan yang sama dalam radius 25 meter, AI mengelompokkannya ke dalam satu tiket induk (<em>parent ticket</em>) agar data tidak tumpang tindih.</li>
<li><strong>Validasi Final Manusia:</strong> Verifikator ASN di Dinas Kominfotik Provinsi Lampung tetap meninjau rekomendasi AI sebelum SPT lapangan diterbitkan, menjamin akurasi dan etika birokrasi.</li>

<!-- Client-side Interactive Search & FAQ Script -->
<script>
    function toggleFaq(button) {
      const parent = button.closest('.faq-item');
      const content = parent.querySelector('.faq-content');
      const icon = button.querySelector('.faq-icon');

      if (content.classList.contains('hidden')) {
        content.classList.remove('hidden');
        icon.classList.add('rotate-180');
      } else {
        content.classList.add('hidden');
        icon.classList.remove('rotate-180');
      }
    }

    function setSearchQuery(query) {
      const input = document.getElementById('guideSearchInput');
      input.value = query;
      filterGuidesAndFaq();
      input.focus();
    }

    function filterGuidesAndFaq() {
      const filter = document.getElementById('guideSearchInput').value.toLowerCase().trim();
      
      // Filter Status Cards
      const statusCards = document.querySelectorAll('#statusGrid .status-card');
      statusCards.forEach(card => {
        const text = card.textContent.toLowerCase();
        if (text.includes(filter)) {
          card.style.display = 'flex';
        } else {
          card.style.display = 'none';
        }
      });

      // Filter FAQ Accordions
      const faqItems = document.querySelectorAll('#faqList .faq-item');
      faqItems.forEach(item => {
        const text = item.textContent.toLowerCase();
        const content = item.querySelector('.faq-content');
        const icon = item.querySelector('.faq-icon');
        
        if (filter === '') {
          item.style.display = 'block';
        } else if (text.includes(filter)) {
          item.style.display = 'block';
          // Auto expand matched FAQ
          content.classList.remove('hidden');
          icon.classList.add('rotate-180');
        } else {
          item.style.display = 'none';
        }
      });
    }

    // Keyboard ESC shortcut to clear search
    document.addEventListener('keydown', function(event) {
      if (event.key === 'Escape') {
        const input = document.getElementById('guideSearchInput');
        if (input && document.activeElement === input) {
          input.value = '';
          filterGuidesAndFaq();
          input.blur();
        }
      }
    });
  </script>

<!-- Interactive JavaScript for Live Elements -->
<script>
    (function() {
      // Live Clock
      function updateClock() {
        const now = new Date();
        const hours = String(now.getHours()).padStart(2, '0');
        const minutes = String(now.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0');
        const seconds = String(now.getSeconds()).padStart(2, '0');
        const clockEl = document.getElementById('clock-display');
        if (clockEl) {
          clockEl.textContent = `${hours}:${minutes}:${seconds} WIB`;
        }
      }
      setInterval(updateClock, 1000);
      updateClock();

      // Simple ticking effect on countdown timers
      function tickCountdowns() {
        ['countdown-1', 'countdown-2', 'countdown-3'].forEach(function(id) {
          const el = document.getElementById(id);
          if (!el) return;
          const parts = el.textContent.split(':');
          let h = parseInt(parts[0], 10);
          let m = parseInt(parts[1], 10);
          let s = parseInt(parts[2], 10);

          if (s > 0) {
            s--;
          } else if (m > 0) {
            m--;
            s = 59;
          } else if (h > 0) {
            h--;
            m = 59;
            s = 59;
          }
          el.textContent = `${String(h).padStart(2,'0')}:${String(m).padStart(2,'0')}:${String(s).padStart(2,'0')}`;
        });
      }
      setInterval(tickCountdowns, 1000);
    })();
  </script>

<script>
  (function() {
    // Interactivity: Reveal citizen sensitive contact details with audit record
    const toggleBtn = document.getElementById('toggle-masked-data');
    const contactBox = document.getElementById('contact-revealed');
    const toast = document.getElementById('action-toast');
    const toastMsg = document.getElementById('toast-message');

    function showToast(text, isError) {
      if (!toast) return;
      toastMsg.innerText = text;
      toast.classList.remove('hidden');
      setTimeout(() => {
        toast.classList.add('hidden');
      }, 3500);
    }

    if (toggleBtn && contactBox) {
      toggleBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
        if (contactBox.classList.contains('hidden')) {
          contactBox.classList.remove('hidden');
          toggleBtn.innerHTML = '<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[16px]">visibility_off</span> Sembunyikan Data Kontak';
          showToast('Audit Trail: Akses data privat pelapor Ahmad Fauzi dicatat oleh operator #DISP-084.');
        } else {
          contactBox.classList.add('hidden');
          toggleBtn.innerHTML = '<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[16px] text-primary">shield</span> Buka Data Kontak Lengkap (Dicatat Audit)';
        }
      });
    }

    // Top action buttons mock triggers
    const btnApprove = document.getElementById('btn-approve');
    const btnReject = document.getElementById('btn-reject');
    const btnNeedInfo = document.getElementById('btn-need-info');

    if (btnApprove) {
      btnApprove.addEventListener('click', function() {
        showToast('Sukses: Laporan #LPG-2026-0845 diteruskan ke Dinas PSDA Wilayah I.');
      });
    }

    if (btnReject) {
      btnReject.addEventListener('click', function() {
        showToast('Dialog Penolakan: Silakan konfirmasi alasan penolakan sebelum pembatalan.');
      });
    }

    if (btnNeedInfo) {
      btnNeedInfo.addEventListener('click', function() {
        showToast('Permintaan Klarifikasi: Notifikasi WhatsApp & Web terkirim ke warga.');
      });
    }
  })();
</script></main></div><footer class="w-full bg-surface-container-lowest py-space-md mt-auto shadow-[0_-1px_8px_rgba(0,0,0,0.02)]"><div class="w-full px-gutter-desktop text-center font-label-sm text-label-sm text-on-surface-variant">Copyright©2026 by Putri Cahyani dan Dr. Erliyan Redy Susanto, M.Kom.       ];
      console.log('CivicAI Filter Triggered');
    }

    function triggerSimulatedDownload() {
      const reason = document.getElementById('export-reason').value;
      if (!reason.trim()) {
        alert('Mohon isi Alasan Ekspor & Kebutuhan Kebijakan sebelum mengunduh berkas pimpinan.');
        return;
      }
      const modal = document.getElementById('export-modal');
      modal.classList.add('hidden');
      alert('Permintaan ekspor diverifikasi oleh Node LPG-01. Berkas laporan eksekutif sedang diproses dan diunduh.');
    }

<script>
  function switchTab(tabId) {
    const tabs = ['users', 'rbac', 'opd', 'jurisdiction'];
    tabs.forEach(t => {
      const content = document.getElementById('tab-' + t);
      const btn = document.getElementById('tab-' + t + '-btn');
      if (content && btn) {
        if (t === tabId) {
          content.classList.remove('hidden');
          btn.classList.add('border-primary', 'text-primary', 'font-semibold');
          btn.classList.remove('border-transparent', 'text-on-surface-variant');
        } else {
          content.classList.add('hidden');
          btn.classList.remove('border-primary', 'text-primary', 'font-semibold');
          btn.classList.add('border-transparent', 'text-on-surface-variant');
        }
      }
    });
  }

  function toggleDrawer(open) {
    const drawer = document.getElementById('drawer-col');
    const tableCol = document.getElementById('table-col');
    if (!drawer || !tableCol) return;
    
    if (open) {
      drawer.classList.remove('hidden');
      tableCol.classList.remove('lg:col-span-12');
      tableCol.classList.add('lg:col-span-8');
    } else {
      drawer.classList.add('hidden');
      tableCol.classList.remove('lg:col-span-8');
      tableCol.classList.add('lg:col-span-12');
    }
  }
</script></main><footer class="w-full bg-surface-container-lowest py-space-lg px-space-xl shadow-[0_-1px_8px_rgba(0,0,0,0.02)]"><div class="w-full flex flex-col md:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-space-sm font-label-sm text-label-sm text-on-surface-variant"><div><span>Copyright©2026 by Putri Cahyani dan Dr. Erliyan Redy Susanto, M.Kom. | Kolaborasi Riset Strategis: Pemerintah Provinsi Lampung &amp; Universitas Teknokrat Indonesia</span></div><div class="flex items-center gap-space-md"><span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-surface-container font-data-mono text-data-mono text-on-surface-variant">CivicAI Infrastructure Node #LPG-01</span></div></div></footer></div></body></html>

<script>
    function toggleAccordion(id) {
      const panel = document.getElementById(id);
      const icon = document.getElementById('icon-' + id);
      if (!panel) return;
      if (panel.classList.contains('hidden')) {
        panel.classList.remove('hidden');
        if (icon) icon.textContent = 'expand_more';
      } else {
        panel.classList.add('hidden');
        if (icon) icon.textContent = 'chevron_right';
      }
    }

    function updateWeightUI() {
      const w1 = parseInt(document.getElementById('w1').value) || 0;
      const w2 = parseInt(document.getElementById('w2').value) || 0;
      const w3 = parseInt(document.getElementById('w3').value) || 0;
      const w4 = parseInt(document.getElementById('w4').value) || 0;

      document.getElementById('val-w1').textContent = w1 + '%';
      document.getElementById('val-w2').textContent = w2 + '%';
      document.getElementById('val-w3').textContent = w3 + '%';
      document.getElementById('val-w4').textContent = w4 + '%';

      const total = w1 + w2 + w3 + w4;
      const badge = document.getElementById('totalWeightBadge');

      if (total === 100) {
        badge.className = 'font-data-mono text-data-mono px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-secondary text-on-secondary font-bold';
        badge.textContent = '100% (Terkalibrasi Sempurna)';
      } else {
        badge.className = 'font-data-mono text-data-mono px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-error text-on-error font-bold';
        badge.textContent = total + '% (Harus Tepat 100%)';
      }
    }

    function focusAuditReason() {
      const input = document.getElementById('auditReasonInput');
      if (input) {
        input.focus();
        input.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
      }
    }

    function submitGovernanceChanges() {
      const input = document.getElementById('auditReasonInput');
      if (!input || !input.value.trim()) {
        alert('Peringatan Tata Kelola: Anda wajib mengisi Catatan / Alasan Perubahan Kebijakan untuk riwayat audit sebelum mempublikasikan.');
        focusAuditReason();
        return;
      }
      alert('Perubahan kebijakan referensi & bobot AI berhasil disimpan dan dipublikasikan secara live ke sistem CivicAI Provinsi Lampung.');
      input.value = '';
    }

    function resetFormState() {
      if (confirm('Batalkan perubahan yang belum disimpan dan kembalikan nilai default?')) {
        document.getElementById('w1').value = 35;
        document.getElementById('w2').value = 25;
        document.getElementById('w3').value = 20;
        document.getElementById('w4').value = 20;
        updateWeightUI();
        const input = document.getElementById('auditReasonInput');
        if (input) input.value = '';
      }
    }

    function filterCategories() {
      const filter = document.getElementById('searchCategoryInput').value.toLowerCase();
      const nodes = document.querySelectorAll('.category-node');
      nodes.forEach(node => {
        const text = node.innerText.toLowerCase();
        node.style.display = text.includes(filter) ? '' : 'none';
      });
    }
  </script>

<script>
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
      const exportModal = document.getElementById('exportModal');
      const btnOpen = document.getElementById('btnOpenExportModal');
      const btnClose = document.getElementById('btnCloseExportModal');
      const btnCancel = document.getElementById('btnCancelExport');
      const btnConfirm = document.getElementById('btnConfirmExport');
      const btnVerify = document.getElementById('btnVerifyHash');

      function openModal() {
        if (exportModal) {
          exportModal.classList.remove('hidden');
        }
      }

      function closeModal() {
        if (exportModal) {
          exportModal.classList.add('hidden');
        }
      }

      if (btnOpen) btnOpen.addEventListener('click', openModal);
      if (btnClose) btnClose.addEventListener('click', closeModal);
      if (btnCancel) btnCancel.addEventListener('click', closeModal);

      if (btnConfirm) {
        btnConfirm.addEventListener('click', () => {
          btnConfirm.innerHTML = '<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[18px] animate-spin">sync</span> Menyiapkan Berkas...';
          setTimeout(() => {
            alert('Permohonan ekspor disetujui. Berkas audit terenkripsi sedang diunduh dengan watermark kredensial Anda.');
            btnConfirm.innerHTML = '<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[18px]">verified</span> Konfirmasi & Unduh Berkas Audit';
            closeModal();
          }, 1000);
        });
      }

      if (btnVerify) {
        btnVerify.addEventListener('click', () => {
          btnVerify.innerHTML = '<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[18px] animate-spin text-primary">sync</span> Memverifikasi Ledger...';
          setTimeout(() => {
            alert('Integritas Kriptografi Valid: Seluruh 48,219 blok log SHA-256 tersinkronisasi tanpa anomali.');
            btnVerify.innerHTML = '<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[18px] text-primary">fact_check</span> Verifikasi Hash Kriptografis';
          }, 800);
        });
      }

      // Close modal on Escape key
      document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
        if (e.key === 'Escape') closeModal();
      });
    });
  </script>

<script>
  (function() {
    // Interactivity: Reveal citizen sensitive contact details with audit record
    const toggleBtn = document.getElementById('toggle-masked-data');
    const contactBox = document.getElementById('contact-revealed');
    const toast = document.getElementById('action-toast');
    const toastMsg = document.getElementById('toast-message');

    function showToast(text, isError) {
      if (!toast) return;
      toastMsg.innerText = text;
      toast.classList.remove('hidden');
      setTimeout(() => {
        toast.classList.add('hidden');
      }, 3500);
    }

    if (toggleBtn && contactBox) {
      toggleBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
        if (contactBox.classList.contains('hidden')) {
          contactBox.classList.remove('hidden');
          toggleBtn.innerHTML = '<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[16px]">visibility_off</span> Sembunyikan Data Kontak';
          showToast('Audit Trail: Akses data privat pelapor Ahmad Fauzi dicatat oleh operator #DISP-084.');
        } else {
          contactBox.classList.add('hidden');
          toggleBtn.innerHTML = '<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[16px] text-primary">shield</span> Buka Data Kontak Lengkap (Dicatat Audit)';
        }
      });
    }

    // Top action buttons mock triggers
    const btnApprove = document.getElementById('btn-approve');
    const btnReject = document.getElementById('btn-reject');
    const btnNeedInfo = document.getElementById('btn-need-info');

    if (btnApprove) {
      btnApprove.addEventListener('click', function() {
        showToast('Sukses: Laporan #LPG-2026-0845 diteruskan ke Dinas PSDA Wilayah I.');
      });
    }

    if (btnReject) {
      btnReject.addEventListener('click', function() {
        showToast('Dialog Penolakan: Silakan konfirmasi alasan penolakan sebelum pembatalan.');
      });
    }

    if (btnNeedInfo) {
      btnNeedInfo.addEventListener('click', function() {
        showToast('Permintaan Klarifikasi: Notifikasi WhatsApp & Web terkirim ke warga.');
      });
    }
  })();
</script></main></div><footer class="w-full bg-surface-container-lowest py-space-md mt-auto shadow-[0_-1px_8px_rgba(0,0,0,0.02)]"><div class="w-full px-gutter-desktop text-center font-label-sm text-label-sm text-on-surface-variant">Copyright©2026 by Putri Cahyani dan Dr. Erliyan Redy Susanto, M.Kom. | Riset Strategis: Pemprov Lampung &amp; Universitas Teknokrat Indonesia</div></footer></div></body></html>

<script>
  (function() {
    // Interactivity: Reveal citizen sensitive contact details with audit record
    const toggleBtn = document.getElementById('toggle-masked-data');
    const contactBox = document.getElementById('contact-revealed');
    const toast = document.getElementById('action-toast');
    const toastMsg = document.getElementById('toast-message');

    function showToast(text, isError) {
      if (!toast) return;
      toastMsg.innerText = text;
      toast.classList.remove('hidden');
      setTimeout(() => {
        toast.classList.add('hidden');
      }, 3500);
    }

    if (toggleBtn && contactBox) {
      toggleBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
        if (contactBox.classList.contains('hidden')) {
          contactBox.classList.remove('hidden');
          toggleBtn.innerHTML = '<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[16px]">visibility_off</span> Sembunyikan Data Kontak';
          showToast('Audit Trail: Akses data privat pelapor Ahmad Fauzi dicatat oleh operator #DISP-084.');
        } else {
          contactBox.classList.add('hidden');
          toggleBtn.innerHTML = '<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[16px] text-primary">shield</span> Buka Data Kontak Lengkap (Dicatat Audit)';
        }
      });
    }

    // Top action buttons mock triggers
    const btnApprove = document.getElementById('btn-approve');
    const btnReject = document.getElementById('btn-reject');
    const btnNeedInfo = document.getElementById('btn-need-info');
    const btnRetry = document.getElementById('btn-ai-retry');

    if (btnApprove) {
      btnApprove.addEventListener('click', function() {
        showToast('Sukses: Laporan #LPG-2026-0845 diteruskan ke Dinas PSDA Wilayah I via verifikasi manual.');
      });
    }

    if (btnReject) {
      btnReject.addEventListener('click', function() {
        showToast('Dialog Penolakan: Silakan konfirmasi alasan penolakan sebelum pembatalan.');
      });
    }

    if (btnNeedInfo) {
      btnNeedInfo.addEventListener('click', function() {
        showToast('Permintaan Klarifikasi: Notifikasi WhatsApp & Web terkirim ke warga.');
      });
    }

    if (btnRetry) {
      btnRetry.addEventListener('click', function() {
        showToast('Mencoba menyambung ke cluster CivicAI... Layanan tetap offline.');
      });
    }
  })();
</script></main></div><footer class="w-full bg-surface-container-lowest py-space-md mt-auto shadow-[0_-1px_8px_rgba(0,0,0,0.02)]"><div class="w-full px-gutter-desktop text-center font-label-sm text-label-sm text-on-surface-variant">Copyright©2026 by Putri Cahyani dan Dr. Erliyan Redy Susanto, M.Kom. | Riset Strategis: Pemprov Lampung &amp; Universitas Teknokrat Indonesia</div></footer></div></body></html>
